The case is listed in the LPC (Local Police Court) Register with permission granted by the Hon’ble Prl. District and Sessions Judge, Adilabad, under Order No. 1467/2018/CRL dated 21-03-2018, to enter the case in the LPC Register.

The matter is being heard in the Court of the Junior Civil Judge, Chennur, represented by Sri G. Uday Bhaskar Rao, PRC.

The case is between the State of Telangana, represented by the SHO, Kotapalli, as Complainant, and Praboina Rajanna as Accused.

The record is duly signed and sealed by the Junior Civil Judge, Chennur, on the 23rd day of March, 2018.

Case number: No. 44 of 1998.
